summary: Allow a reviewed reusable CI plan during fresh native bootstrap without changing target CI before real allocation. SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: continue pending scanner issues and independently publish.

delivery.outcome: Fresh bootstrap derives the future immutable reusable check contract from an externally reviewed bounded plan while preserving committed target caller bytes; native allocation still precedes target CI implementation and protected publication.
nonGoals: No writes to target-owned workflows before native allocation
No mutable-source resolution, network fetching or publication authority from a bootstrap plan
No foreign checkout cleanup or policy waiver

architecture.decision: Resolve one exact committed caller and full-SHA callee in a temporary offline workflow mirror. Install only standard-managed bootstrap files; preserve target workflows and prove real allocation and refusal of invalid plans.
interfaceChanges: Optional external --bootstrap-reusable-plan JSON for fresh first allocation
dataChanges: Closed digest-bound planned workflow input, without execution authority
architecture.rollback: Publish a reviewed correction; preserve target files and required checks.

validation.evidence: Exact source pin/digest, invalid input refusals and unchanged primary caller with genuine first allocation.
Existing fresh/legacy adoption and native package gates remain passing.

commands: Independent exact-head publication and managed standard release
validation.evidence: Protected merge and immutable release precede production consumer adoption.
